picks.what: View across the Dnieper, aquatint in John Thomas James’s Journal of a Tour in Germany, Sweden, Russia, Poland
picks.why: general view with the Dormition Cathedral above the town and the fortress walls; plate margins trimmed

picks.what: View from Cathedral Hill, early color photograph
picks.why: color view over the town with churches, the fortress wall and the Dnieper bridge

picks.what: The city seen from a war-ruined suburb, photograph
picks.why: general view with the cathedral on the skyline; foreground in ruins, so marked as event

picks.what: The fortress wall and towers above the old town, photograph
picks.why: the city’s signature fortress wall with the Thunder Tower, in color

notes: #1: James made the drawing on his 1813–14 tour; the scan is from the 1817 edition (a first edition appeared in 1816, possibly with the same plate). #2 is a view of Vyazma, not Smolensk. #3/#4 (Albrecht Adam) show the 1812 battle and are the same period as #1. #6, #8, #9 are postcards dated only “before 1917”. #12 (2010) also shows the cathedral but is small and dull.
